description: This Java class 'BitmapHelper' provides utility methods for image processing, including scaling bitmaps, calculating scale factors, and fetching and rescaling bitmaps from a URL.

classes.name: BitmapHelper
classes.description: A utility class for handling bitmap scaling, decoding, and fetching from URLs.

methods.name: scaleBitmap
methods.description: Scales a bitmap to fit within specified maximum width and height while maintaining aspect ratio.

methods.name: scaleBitmap
methods.description: Decodes an InputStream into a scaled bitmap using a specified scale factor.

methods.name: findScaleFactor
methods.description: Calculates the scale factor needed to resize an image to target dimensions based on InputStream data.

methods.name: fetchAndRescaleBitmap
methods.description: Fetches an image from a URL and rescales it to specified dimensions.
